description: SpaceJet Innovators is a team participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge, using creativity, technology, and innovation to solve real-world challenges on Earth and in space.
summary: SpaceJet is a space mission design game where players take the role of space engineers. They can design spacecraft, choose equipment and rockets, and manage resources to complete missions. The game helps players understand how engineering decisions affect a mission's success and makes learning about space exploration more interesting and enjoyable.
details:
SpaceJet makes space mission planning easy to understand. Players design missions to Mars, the Moon, or Earth orbit by selecting rockets, equipment, and parts while managing budget, weight, fuel, and power limits.

The game demonstrates how engineering choices affect results, explaining why missions succeed or fail. Through interactive design, players learn the core challenges of space exploration.

Developed using Android Studio, C++, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and OpenGL ES, the project features a clean 2D interface. A C++ simulation engine evaluates designs using official NASA science mission guidelines.

The primary goal is to make space education engaging and provide a clear look into spacecraft engineering.
